spec.title: 최근 24시간 API 호출
spec.description: 429가 늘면 호출 간격 조정

spec.rawSql:
SELECT api AS `API`, COUNT(*) AS `호출`, SUM(status_code = 200) AS `성공`, SUM(status_code = 429) AS `429`,
       SUM(status_code <> 200) AS `실패`, ROUND(SUM(status_code <> 200) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS `실패율(%)`, MAX(req_at) AS `마지막 호출`
FROM API_SYNC_LOG
WHERE req_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY api
ORDER BY api

spec.title: API별 수집 실패율 (1시간 단위)
spec.description: req_at은 KST로 저장돼 있어 UTC로 바꿔서 그린다

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t, '1h'), api AS metric,
       ROUND(SUM(status_code <> 200) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS fail_pct
FROM (SELECT CONVERT_TZ(req_at, '+09:00', '+00:00') AS t, api, status_code FROM API_SYNC_LOG) x
WHERE $__timeFilter(t)
GROUP BY 1, api
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: 울리고 있는 알림
spec.description: Prometheus 알림 규칙 중 지금 firing 상태인 것

spec.title: 오늘 수집에 성공하지 않은 게임
spec.description: 행이 있으면 03:00 수집 배치 확인. 비어 있으면 정상

spec.rawSql:
SELECT g.appid, g.name AS `게임`, MAX(l.req_at) AS `마지막 성공`
FROM GAME g
LEFT JOIN API_SYNC_LOG l ON l.appid = g.appid AND l.status_code = 200
GROUP BY g.appid, g.name
HAVING `마지막 성공` IS NULL OR `마지막 성공` < CURDATE()
ORDER BY `마지막 성공`
